name: code_parallel_handoff_summary
description: Deterministic code_parallel decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

verification.description: Verification outcome (e.g. code_parallel_verification_outcome output); shallow-copied into the output with 'presented' added. Only its 'passed' field is inspected.

matched.description: Whether the verified candidate is exactly what got presented downstream; only literal true counts.

data.description: A shallow copy of the 'verification' input object with 'presented' added; every other key varies with whatever verification contained.

presented.description: True only when matched is literal true and verification.passed is literal true.
